findings.problem: Closing or submitting one distance consent suppresses all pending distance consents, including other orders, before any request succeeds.
findings.scenario: orders A/DC1 and B/DC2 pending; tap A agree/reject/later -> handled includes both distance:DC1 and distance:DC2. If A POST fails, A is also permanently hidden for this composition; B was never presented.
findings.minimumFix: Only mark current account/order/consent key, only after successful done for approve/reject. Later should defer only current prompt, never silently consume other orders. Keep failure visible/retryable.

findings.problem: Saved handled keys are not scoped/reset by account.
findings.scenario: handledText rememberSaveable remains mounted across logged false return and login; account A suppression keys carry into B, and back into A. This is inconsistent with account-specific draft/announcement state; consent key lacks order/account identity.
findings.minimumFix: Key saved state to passenger owner (and order/consent identity), reset on account change/logout; do not reuse another account handled set.

findings.problem: GPS auto-fill consumes cached position without consumer freshness/quality checks and never replaces the first coarse fix.
findings.scenario: PositionBus retains a nonnull older fix. Draft opened later copies it regardless fix.time; accuracy has only provider >0 check (arbitrarily coarse allowed). originFromGps=true then blocks better updates; effect keyed on position!=null never observes new nonnull fix. Automatic label suggests current phone pickup.
findings.minimumFix: Use full fix identity/timestamp and explicit finite/range/accuracy/freshness guard at use, allow fresher/better updates until manual confirmation, preserve originTouched; recheck before async reverse result. Do not treat originFromGps as permanent lock.

findings.problem: Automatic navigation checks resulting stage only, not an actual stage transition or unique leg.
findings.scenario: TRIP finish when distance gate needs passenger consent: backend gate_shared_advance returns success with same TRIP + PENDING. perform.done calls navigateForNewLeg; it sees TRIP and opens external navigation again though no new leg began. Retrying same consent repeats launch.
findings.minimumFix: Pass expected prior stage and verify successful target transition, e.g. RESERVED->PICKUP or ARRIVED->TRIP, plus account/order/leg dedupe; no navigation for unchanged-stage consent request or idempotent replay.

findings.problem: Expiry depends only on incidental recomposition; malformed/missing expiry is treated unexpired.
findings.scenario: Displayed pending prompt can remain approve-enabled after expiresAt passes while refresh offline. close() hides it then backend rejects as expired. Existing check covers initial status/stage but no action-time freshness/current-consent validation.
findings.minimumFix: Validate current order/consent/account/stage/expiry at click, fail closed for invalid expiry, drive expiry update or dismiss/refresh without answering; preserve backend authoritative validation.
